app.name: Snapchat
app.description: A multimedia messaging app known for ephemeral photos and videos, creative filters, and location-based features like Snap Map.

verdict.one_liner: Heavy data collection for ads and personalization; chats auto-delete but shadow profiles exist from contacts.
verdict.summary: Snapchat collects extensive data including device information, location, contacts, and usage behavior to personalize content and ads. While private communications are not used for ad targeting and chats auto-delete within 24 hours, the platform creates shadow profiles from other users' contact uploads and shares data broadly with partners.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Snapchat's ephemeral messaging is genuine for chats, but the platform collects extensive data for personalization and advertising. Consider your privacy tolerance and adjust ad settings and contact permissions accordingly.

red.title: Heavy ad personalization using your interests across the platform
red.plain_english: Snapchat uses your interests and preferences from collected information to personalize, target, and measure ads. It tracks what content you view, engage with, and save to build an advertising profile.

red.title: Creates shadow profiles from other users' contact uploads
red.plain_english: If another Snapchat user uploads their contact list which includes your information, Snapchat may combine that with other information it has about you to understand who you may want to communicate with, even if you've never shared your contacts.

red.title: Extensive device fingerprinting including installed apps
red.plain_english: Snapchat collects detailed device information including hardware, software, OS, device memory, advertising identifiers, list of apps installed, browser type, device sensors, and wireless connections.

red.title: Extensive data sharing with advertisers and partners
red.plain_english: Snapchat shares information with service providers, business partners, anti-fraud partners, advertisers, and affiliates. Data is used for ad targeting, fraud prevention, and service improvement.

red.title: Vague data retention: kept 'as long as we need it'
red.plain_english: Snapchat states it keeps information as long as you tell it to, and otherwise 'as long as we need it' to provide services or comply with legal requirements. This broad language allows indefinite retention.

green.title: Private Snaps and Chats are NOT used for ad personalization
green.plain_english: Snapchat explicitly states it does not use private content and communications you send to friends to personalize your experience, make recommendations, or show you ads.

green.title: Messages delete by default within 24 hours
green.plain_english: Snapchat's systems are designed to delete Chats within 24 hours after being opened by all recipients, unless you've changed default settings or decide to save them.

green.title: Private communications NOT shared with third-party service providers
green.plain_english: Snapchat states it does not share private communications with service providers, maintaining separation between your private messages and external partners.

green.title: TrueDepth camera data used in real-time only, not stored
green.plain_english: On iOS, Snapchat uses Apple's TrueDepth camera to improve Lenses, but this information is processed in real-time only and is not stored on servers or shared with third parties.

green.title: Family Center provides parental oversight for teens
green.plain_english: Family Center allows parents or guardians to monitor teen accounts, including friends list and location sharing, though message content is not shared.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Full camera and microphone access for Snaps, video calls, and content creation. TrueDepth camera used for Lenses in real-time only.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone are core to Snapchat's functionality. Users can take photos, record videos, make voice/video calls, and apply Lenses. TrueDepth camera data on iOS is used in real-time only and not stored.
categories.policy_excerpt: images and other information from your device's camera, photos, and microphone... On iOS we use Apple's TrueDepth camera to improve the quality of Lenses. Note, however, that this information is used in real time

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: IP address collected automatically; precise GPS location collected if permission granted, including with Snaps posted to Snap Map and Spotlight.
categories.detail: IP address is collected automatically for all users. Precise GPS location is only collected when explicitly granted permission. Location data is stored with Snaps saved to Memories, Snap Map, and Spotlight submissions.
categories.policy_excerpt: location information (IP address). location information (precise location through methods like GPS signals)
concerns: Precise GPS location shared with friends if Snap Map enabled

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Full device contacts access if granted. Creates shadow profiles from other users' contact uploads without your consent.
categories.detail: Device phonebook access requires explicit permission for friend finding. Additionally, if another user uploads contacts containing your information, Snapchat may combine it with other data it has about you to understand who you may want to communicate with.
categories.policy_excerpt: information about your device phonebook (contacts and related information). if another Snapchatter uploads their contact list which includes your information, we may combine that with other information we have about you
concerns: Shadow profiles created from other users' contact uploads
Contact info used to determine alternate communication methods

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Full access to device photos and camera roll for saving Snaps to Memories and uploading content.
categories.detail: Users can save Snaps to Memories, upload photos and videos from device to Stories and Spotlight. Access requires explicit permission.
categories.policy_excerpt: images and other information from your device's camera, photos, and microphone
concerns: Saved media persists on servers until deleted

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Extensive data sharing with service providers, advertisers, business partners, anti-fraud partners, and affiliates. Does not share private communications.
categories.detail: Data is shared with service providers (payments, ad measurement), advertisers (targeting and measurement), business partners, anti-fraud partners, and affiliates. Private communications are not shared with most partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: We share your information with our service providers... We share your information with business and integrated partners... We share your information, such as device and usage information, with industry partners working to prevent fraud
concerns: Data shared with advertisers for ad targeting
Shared with business and integrated partners

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Standard account data collected: name, username, email, birthday, phone number, Bitmoji, and profile picture.
categories.detail: Basic account details include name, username, email address, birthday, and phone number. Profile details include Bitmoji and profile picture. Users can access and update most information in app settings. Two-factor authentication available.
categories.policy_excerpt: account details (information about you, like your name, username, email address, birthday, and phone number). profile details (like your Bitmoji and profile picture)

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Heavy ad personalization using interests, preferences, cookies, pixels, and advertising identifiers across platforms.
categories.detail: Snapchat uses interests and preferences to personalize, target, and measure ads. Uses cookies, pixels, and unique advertising identifiers. Content analysis used for targeting (e.g., dog in photo → dog food ads). Cross-platform tracking when linking to other services. Private communications NOT used for ad personalization.
categories.policy_excerpt: we use your interests and preferences from the information we've collected to personalize, target, and measure ads. cookies, pixels... unique advertising identifiers

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Services directed to users 13+. Accounts deleted if underage use discovered. Additional protections for teens via Family Center.
categories.detail: Services explicitly for individuals 13 and older. Under-13 accounts deleted if discovered. Family Center allows parents/guardians to monitor teen accounts. Some features limited for users under 18.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Services are not directed to children under the age of 13, and you must confirm that you are 13 years or older... If we have actual knowledge that you are under the age of 13... we will stop providing Services to you and delete your account and data.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Usage logs including access times, pages viewed, IP address, and interaction data collected.
categories.detail: Log information includes access times, pages viewed, IP address, unique identifiers. Usage information about interactions with Services collected, including Lenses viewed, Stories watched, and interactions.
categories.policy_excerpt: log information (such as details about how you've used our Services, access times, pages viewed, IP address, and unique identifiers like cookies)

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Extensive device data collected: hardware, software, OS, device memory, advertising identifiers, installed apps, browser, sensors, wireless connections.
categories.detail: Collects hardware and software information, OS, device memory, advertising identifiers, list of apps installed, browser type, device sensors (motion, compass, microphone), headphone connection status, and wireless/mobile connections.
categories.policy_excerpt: device information (such as your hardware or software, operating system, device memory, advertising identifiers, apps installed, browser type, information from device sensors... and information about your wireless and mobile connections)

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: TrueDepth camera data used for Lenses in real-time only; not stored on servers or shared. No health data collection mentioned.
categories.detail: TrueDepth camera is used on iOS for Lens effects. Data is processed in real-time only and is not stored on servers or shared with third parties. No other biometric or health data collection mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: On iOS we use Apple's TrueDepth camera to improve the quality of Lenses. Note, however, that this information is used in real time — we don't store this information on our servers or share it with third parties.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payment information collected for commerce products including physical address and transaction history.
categories.detail: Payment and shipping information collected for purchases through commerce products. Transaction history stored. Processed by service providers. Only collected when using commerce features.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you use our commerce products to buy something... we may ask you for payment and related information (like your physical address... payment information... and transaction history)

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Account deletion and data download available. Chats auto-delete within 24 hours, but retention is vague ('as long as we need it').
categories.detail: Account deletion available through app settings. Data download tool available for exporting information. Snaps and Chats auto-delete within 24 hours after being opened. Memories stored until user deletes. Retention language is broad: 'as long as we need it'. Data may be retained for legal compliance, dispute resolution, or abuse investigation.
categories.policy_excerpt: we keep information as long as you tell us to, and otherwise as long as we need it. we may need to comply with legal requirements to store your data which stops us from deleting your information

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Changes posted with revised date; additional notice (in-app notification or email) for material changes.
categories.detail: Changes effective immediately upon posting. Revised date shown at top of policy. Material changes notified via in-app notification or email. Support site has latest retention period information.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time... Sometimes, we'll let you know by revising the date at the top of the Privacy Policy... Other times, we may provide you with additional notice (such as... providing you with an in-app notification)
